text: The derivative of cotangent and the derivative of cosecant each include a negative sign, and omitting either sign costs the result point. The worked solution shows that when the fraction (-1 - cos x)/sin^2 x is split into two parts, the first part -1/sin^2 x becomes -csc^2 x and the second part -cos x/sin^2 x becomes -csc x cot x, giving the final answer -csc^2 x - csc x cot x with both negative signs present.
